title: Cutting RAG inference costs 6x starts with deciding what never reaches the LLM
summary: Most teams building retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems for high stakes classification make the same architectural bet: Route every ambiguous case straight to the language model and trust the retrieved context to sort it out.
